title: Lonidamine-1,3,4-oxadiazole derivatives with antiproliferative effects on HCT116 colon cancer cell lines: biological evaluation, ADMET, and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13624-13643
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07852K, Paper

Herein, we have employed a structure-based approach, designed and synthesized conjugates of lonidamine-1,3,4-oxadiazole, and evaluated its cytotoxicity profile on a colorectal cancer cell line.
